title: Babysitting marketplace
whyItFails: Trust is local. Parents prefer word-of-mouth sitters. Disintermediation. Good matches go direct. Liability. Safety incidents are catastrophic.
whatWouldChange: Employer-paid childcare benefits creating a paying buyer.

attempts.notes: A 2019 Wall Street Journal investigation found it listed childcare providers as licensed when they were not.

attempts.outcome: Closed; technology put up for sale
attempts.notes: Help families schedule their babysitters and grow their sitter network.

reasons.detail: Trust is local: Parents prefer word-of-mouth sitters.
